Deepti Sharma Becomes Leading Wicket-Taker in Women's T20Is

Indian cricketer Deepti Sharma has become the leading wicket-taker in women's T20 Internationals, surpassing the previous record. She achieved this milestone during a match, taking her total wickets to 171. Sharma's achievement marks a significant moment in women's cricket history for India.
